name: Sync AI Connector Docs

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 */6 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  sync-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout airbyte repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_BOT_TOKEN }}

      - name: Checkout airbyte-ai-connectors repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: airbytehq/airbyte-ai-connectors
          path: airbyte-ai-connectors
          token: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_BOT_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.10"

      - name: Sync AI connector docs
        id: sync
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          
          SRC_DIR="airbyte-ai-connectors/connectors"
          DEST_DIR="docs/ai-agents/connectors"
          
          # Clean destination directory
          rm -rf "$DEST_DIR"
          mkdir -p "$DEST_DIR"
          
          # Copy all markdown files from each connector directory
          find "$SRC_DIR" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | while read -r connector_dir; do
            connector_name=$(basename "$connector_dir")
            echo "Processing connector: $connector_name"
            
            # Create connector subdirectory
            mkdir -p "$DEST_DIR/$connector_name"
            
            # Copy all .md files from connector directory
            find "$connector_dir" -name "*.md" -exec cp {} "$DEST_DIR/$connector_name/" \;
          done
          
          # Check if there are any changes
          if git diff --quiet; then
            echo "No changes detected"
            echo "changed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "Changes detected"
            echo "changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.sync.outputs.changed == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_BOT_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: sync AI connector docs from airbyte-ai-connectors"
          title: "chore: sync AI connector docs from airbyte-ai-connectors"
          body: |
            This PR automatically syncs AI connector documentation from the airbyte-ai-connectors repository.
            
            Changes were detected and this PR was created automatically.
          branch: sync-ai-connector-docs
          labels: |
            documentation
            auto-merge
          delete-branch: true
